text: Worked Example: One-Dimensional Minimization Minimize f(x) = x? whose global optimum is at x* = 0. Take an initial population: PO = {4, -3 2} Suppose mutation produces: PMW = (35, —22,2.8} These offspring are better than the original ones, but they are still not close to the optimum: f(3.5) = 12.25, f(—2.2) = 4.84, f(2.8) =7.84 A memetic algorithm now applies a local improvement step before replacement.
